title: Depth drops by one modulo a nonzerodivisor in the maximal ideal
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] (a Noetherian commutative ring with exactly one maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$), $M\neq0$ a finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and $x\in\mathfrak m$ a nonzerodivisor on $M$ (multiplication by $x$ on $M$ is injective). Then $M/xM\neq0$, $\operatorname{depth}(M)$ is a finite integer $\ge1$, and $\operatorname{depth}(M/xM)=\operatorname{depth}(M)-1$, where $\operatorname{depth}=\operatorname{depth}_{\mathfrak m}$ is the depth of a finite $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-depth].
